title: 17th Annual Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference
summary: Download the presentation from the 17th Annual Midwest IDEAS Conference with Quad's Chief Financial Officer Tony Staniak.
body_markdown:
Members of Quad management will participate in the Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference at The InterContinental Chicago Magnificent Mile in Chicago on


Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Tony Staniak, Quad Chief Financial Officer and


Treasurer, will present and host one-on-one and small group meetings with


investors. The presentation will be accessible through the conference host’s


main website at[https://www.threepartadvisors.com/midwest](https://www.threepartadvisors.com/midwest) . For additional


information or to schedule a meeting with management, please contact Quad’s


investor relations team at IR@quad.com.
